4557.title: ACP cancellation failure and session recovery
4557.rootCauseOneLine: BB cancels before steering and recovers from a synthetic adapter error; the Hermes exception and retained running state remain unverified.
4557.proposedFix: Reproduce with the exact Hermes revision and a sanitized cancellation traceback before choosing an adapter or bridge repair.
4557.caveats: Hermes is unavailable here. Verified means the limited bridge probe was repeated in a second clean checkout, not that the incident was reproduced. Test code is inline in the HTML; no private runtime data or upstream code was inspected.
